An '''orgone bubbler''' was a fizzy, fruity drink.

The [[Thalassa Tarkin|Lady Tarkin]] offered [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] an orgone bubbler during the banquet preceding the [[Thirteenth Imperial Diplomatic Conclave]]. Vader declined, citing his inability to ingest food of any kind.
